description: Demo alert cases for the application operations fault-analysis workflow. Each alert has a matching local log entry under demo/ecom/logs and a seeded vector in spaces/ops/alert-history.json.

cases.title: 售后退款空指针
cases.alert: 售后退款申请失败，服务 ecom-aftersales，接口 POST /api/aftersales/refund，traceId=aftersales-null-20260712-001，NullPointerException，refundContext 为空，影响用户退款
cases.expectedCategoryHint: 空指针 / 业务上下文缺失

cases.title: 售后查询交易超时
cases.alert: 售后退货创建失败，服务 ecom-aftersales，接口 POST /api/aftersales/return，traceId=aftersales-trade-timeout-20260712-002，查询 ecom-trade 订单详情 timeout，退货链路响应慢

cases.title: 支付回调重复导致状态冲突
cases.alert: 支付回调处理失败，服务 ecom-payment，接口 POST /api/payment/callback，traceId=payment-callback-dup-20260712-003，DuplicatePaymentCallbackException，支付状态 PAID 与 PAYING 冲突
cases.expectedCategoryHint: 业务数据不一致 / 幂等异常

cases.title: 库存扣减失败导致超卖风险
cases.alert: 库存扣减失败，服务 ecom-inventory，接口 POST /api/inventory/deduct，traceId=inventory-stock-negative-20260712-004，BusinessDataInconsistencyException，available stock would become negative，存在超卖风险
cases.expectedCategoryHint: 业务数据不一致 / 库存超卖

cases.title: 物流轨迹同步超时
cases.alert: 物流轨迹同步失败，服务 ecom-logistics，接口 POST /api/logistics/tracking/sync，traceId=logistics-track-timeout-20260712-005，carrier tracking API timeout，履约轨迹更新延迟
